notes: Masculine, lemma in -s or -š (galds, ceļš). nom.sg is always the lemma itself, so the 's' cell is documentation only.
ins.sg = acc.sg and ins.pl = dat.pl throughout Latvian: the instrumental is used after 'ar'.
